description: Missing thread-related validation: (1) threadRootId must reference a valid existing message in the same chat (spec lines 508-515); (2) replyTo must reference an existing message in the same chat. Missing expiry/retention fields: senderExpiresAt must be in the future at creation time; burnOnRead handling; messageExpirySeconds on the chat sets per-chat TTL.
title: Message/set: thread support and expiry validation
